name: peacock-butterfly
_about: A peacock butterfly (Aglais io), 6 cm across the wings: maroon-red, with a great peacock's eye on each wing -- lilac, yellow and black on the forewing, blue ringed black on the hindwing; the forewing's costa barred black and cream; beneath almost black, like charred bark. A brush-foot: four walking legs, the first pair shrunk to brushes. Basking with its wings spread flat. Written whole by tools/creaturegen/rework/winged/butterflies.py on insectlib.py + wlib.py (each wing one sheet, its upperside's painting laid on it as thin sheets in layers -- the 2D butterflies' own paintings, assets/butterflies/; the wings beat in the variant "flying").
